limitation: Prospective fixed readout recipe on an adaptive discovery bank, not final confirmation, natural causal use or mechanism C. Sites 3, 7 and 8 alone are fitted; other captured sites are reserved for later work. Raw 4096-dimensional hidden coordinates and matched 4096 character-ngram features have train-only float64 normalization and fixed alpha 100. Independent relation columns and value columns share a Gram factorization without output coupling. Primary algebraic comparisons use relations derived from four independent 32-class categorical value heads; rounded/clipped scalar-value derivation is secondary. Whole-pipeline parameter counts differ, so this is not an equal-total-capacity comparison. Numeric values, graph/stratum IDs and oracle relations never enter readout features. Binary ridge outputs are uncalibrated scores, with threshold 0.5. Undefined and constant tasks are retained and reported, not claimed as relationship learning. Primary eligibility uses only training group class support; all fixed eligible development cells must contain both classes. Components, not numeric/lexical relatives, are uncertainty units. Three seeds change component weights and coherent shuffle tasks, not independent experiments. Component derangements move initialization-prefix base blocks, with copy-parent permutations inside each base and lexical ties retained. This preserves unweighted target marginals, not necessarily weighted marginals. Conditional intervals resample nine development components without refitting or multiplicity adjustment. Successful relation decoding alone does not establish a dedicated relational representation or an identified algorithm.
